_comment: Review comment anchors (mobile POC spec 6.2): a review ask's doc_snapshot (markdown), the plain text Core's DocumentRendering renders it to (headings with UTF-16 offsets into it), a selection on that text (UTF-16 location/length) and the anchor Core's CommentAnchor makes of it (context_length characters on either side, the nearest preceding heading). Core's CommentAnchorFixtureTests and the Kit's CommentAnchorBuilderTests both run every case. A doc_clipped case is the head of a snapshot the hub cut at the last newline before its cap (OwnerAskSlice.clipSnapshot). The spec_review_comment_on_a_rendered_list_item case is also where SpecReviewAnswer (Core) and the Go hub place a review finding quoting "Copy the **users** table": the same quote, prefix, suffix and heading.
